projects.title: EcoTracker - Sustainability Dashboard
projects.description: A comprehensive web application that helps users track their environmental impact through daily activities. Features real-time analytics, goal setting, and community challenges.
projects.longDescription: EcoTracker is a full-stack web application designed to promote environmental consciousness by allowing users to monitor and reduce their carbon footprint. The platform includes features like activity logging, impact visualization, goal setting, and social challenges to encourage sustainable living.

projects.title: TaskMaster Pro - Project Management
projects.description: An advanced project management platform with team collaboration features, time tracking, and automated reporting capabilities.
projects.longDescription: TaskMaster Pro is a comprehensive project management solution built for modern teams. It combines intuitive task management with powerful collaboration tools, real-time updates, and detailed analytics to help teams stay productive and organized.

projects.title: FoodieFind - Restaurant Discovery
projects.description: A mobile-first web application that helps users discover nearby restaurants with personalized recommendations based on preferences and dietary restrictions.
projects.longDescription: FoodieFind leverages location-based services and machine learning to provide personalized restaurant recommendations. Users can filter by cuisine, dietary restrictions, price range, and ratings to find the perfect dining experience.

projects.title: CryptoPortfolio - Investment Tracker
projects.description: A real-time cryptocurrency portfolio tracker with advanced analytics, price alerts, and market insights.
projects.longDescription: CryptoPortfolio provides comprehensive cryptocurrency investment tracking with real-time price updates, portfolio analytics, and market insights. Users can track their investments, set price alerts, and analyze market trends.
